title: Hide and Seek with 1Cuddlepup
description: Hide and Seek with 1Cuddlepup. a simple fabric server with Hide and Seek enabled for 1Cuddlepup's Twitch server
body:
This modpack is designed to turn Minecraft into a fast-paced, unpredictable game of stealth, misdirection, and pure chaos. Whether you're blending into the environment or hunting down suspiciously placed “blocks,” every round is a mix of tension and laughter.

Built around the Hide and Seek mod, this pack strips away unnecessary clutter and focuses on smooth gameplay, fair challenges, and streamer-friendly fun. Perfect for community games, Twitch events, or just messing around with friends.

- Classic Hide & Seek gameplay – disguise yourself, stay still, and don’t get caught
- Balanced environment – no heavy progression or grindy mechanics
- Quality-of-life mods – smoother performance, better visuals, and cleaner gameplay
- Streamer-ready setup – ideal for playing with 1Cuddlepup and community members
- Light chaos energy – just enough unpredictability to keep things interesting

Includes a curated selection of mods such as:

- Hide and Seek (core gameplay)
- Carpet Mod (server control & tweaks)
- Lootr, Graves (shared loot & player-friendly mechanics)
- Performance and worldgen improvements
- Small enhancements for smoother, more enjoyable rounds
